keywords: Criminal and juvenile justice procedures 2.crime investigation, trial, correction, and rehabilitation service 3.Family court 4.support of Assailants and Victims 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Judicial ・ criminal psychology is a learning discipline that studies and practices the use of psychological knowledge and techniques in judicial proceedings related to crimes. Students will learn the roles of psychological professionals in this field and the way psychology should be used by grasping the laws and systems of criminal and juvenile justice and understanding the work and cooperation of related institutions and facilities.
advice: The lecture will focus on the laws and systems of criminal and juvenile justice, and the work of related institutions and facilities.
